title: Pompeo: 'I saw the UFO files, too'

tellings.quote: But I will say this is a very weird non-sequitur from former CIA Director Mike Pompeo, when asked why the nearly 5000 JFK files still won't be released to this day.

Pompeo when he was interviewed by judge NPO aano very awkward kind of segue from you know was like are you going to release the JFK files he goes no you know we can't do that some of the people are still alive and then he goes uh you know I've seen the the UAP files as well
tellings.difference: Names Judge Napolitano as the interviewer and gives Pompeo's reason for withholding the files: some of the people are still alive.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Pompeo's odd segue from the withheld JFK files to saying he had also seen the UFO/UAP files.

as_told.title: Pompeo links the withheld JFK files to the UAP files in his Napolitano interview

plain: Mike Pompeo, a former director of the CIA, the US spy agency, is said to have dropped an odd remark about secret UFO files while being asked about something else. Michels brings it up in 2023, calling it a "very weird non-sequitur." Pompeo had been asked why nearly 5,000 files on the killing of President John F. Kennedy, known as the JFK files, still had not been released. The journalist Michael Shellenberger tells the same moment and names the interviewer as a commentator called Judge Napolitano. In his telling, Pompeo said no, they could not release them because some of the people are still alive, and then added that he had seen the UAP files as well, UAP being the government's term for UFOs. Both are describing a public interview they watched. It catches attention because it would suggest a top official has seen hidden UFO records and links them in his mind to other secrets.
